_comment: kke_demo's items (kke::ItemCatalog, docs/SHOWCASE.md). size is [width, height] in bag cells; weight in kg for one; stack is how many share a cell; equip lists the slots it may go in (LeftHand, RightHand, Back, HipLeft, HipRight, Head). What each looks like is in games/showcase/Items.cpp, by id.

items.name: Wood axe
items.description: A short felling axe. Hold it in your right hand, or carry it on your back.

items.name: Hunting rifle
items.description: Thirty rounds; hold the trigger and it keeps firing. Aim with LT or the right mouse button. Slung on your back it leaves your hands free.

items.name: Pistol
items.description: Twelve rounds, one shot a pull. Wear it on a hip to keep it handy.

items.name: Grenade
items.description: In your right hand the trigger throws it; it goes off three seconds later. Four to a cell.

items.name: Canteen
items.description: A litre of water. Clips onto your belt.

items.name: Helmet
items.description: A steel helmet. Wear it on your head.

items.name: Lantern
items.description: Carry it in your left hand or hang it on your belt.

items.name: Firewood
items.description: Split logs. Four to a pile.
